entities.summary: Yu Xuanji, courtesy names Youwei and Huilan, was a Chinese female poet, courtesan, and Daoist nun during the late Tang dynasty who was born in Chang'an. Along with Xue Tao, she was one of the foremost poets of the Tang dynasty.
